main_text.l: rum Sauli, pro filia ejus Michol præsen-
taffet præputia. Neque his tamen in
m ejus alteri tradidit, ipsum ac parentes
fuos patria expulit, ejus caufa Sacerdo-
rum civitatem, unà cum viris & mulie-
no exercitu à loco ad locum, ejus ani-
ufpiam; justa cuiquam dari poffit ratio
regem iniuftum è medio auferendi, Da-
vidi ista datur. Quid interim ille? quas
magis quàm de tollendo, de ferendo
quàm de feriendo: imò,à feriendo tan-
tum abhorruit, ut cùm femel in spe-
lunca, & iterum in tentorio ei daretur

page.notes: The right-hand column is empty. Possible printing or reading doubts: "fopiiffet" (likely "fopiffet"/"fopiiffet" as printed), "ufquam", "iniuftum" and "ufpiam" are transcribed as printed. The first line begins with a fragment "fica" that continues from the previous page and is kept as a fragment. Last line "potuit)" is printed with a closing parenthesis. The catchword and signature are not visible.
